deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.howTo: Send BTC to the address below, then enter the amount in USD and the transaction hash.
deposit.manualNote: Deposits are credited after an administrator manually verifies the transaction. This may take some time.
deposit.successText: Your deposit request has been sent. The balance will be credited after the transaction is verified.

withdraw.title: Withdraw
withdraw.howTo: Withdrawals are paid in USDT on the TRON (TRC20) network.
withdraw.manualNote: The amount is reserved right away and sent after an administrator processes the request.
withdraw.successText: The amount has been reserved. You'll get a notification once the withdrawal is processed.
